correctness.rationale: For a finite affine plane, three distinct positive points either are collinear, forcing one covering line, or form a triangle, whose 2-line covers contain a triangle side and a pencil through the opposite vertex. For any additional positive x, if off all sides at most three candidate pairs survive (positive branch rank<=1); if on a side that side is forced and the remaining pencil has rank<=1. Thus the restriction after three positive points has Littlestone dimension at most two. Predicting unseen points 0 until the third distinct positive makes at most three initial errors; optimal restricted learning adds at most two, so online dimension <=5. For q>=4, explicit two-axis 5-point set with cross-lines nonparallel realizes all 32 Boolean traces, so VCdim>=5 implies Ldim>=5. q=2 concepts are four singleton complements, rank1; q=3 54 concepts have exact minimax rank4; independent enumeration confirms q=2,3,4 and q=4 five-point witness. No Desarguesian assumption used in unbounded geometric proof. Different positive branch cases and safe-line counts checked.
residual_risks: Only unions of exactly two distinct nonparallel affine lines, all existing finite affine planes; no nonexisting plane orders or unions of more lines.
